title: skills: objectstack-platform's requires: table calls every listed service opt-in, but package-registry and other tokens are always-on
body:
domain:skills#3 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAj7CvjkGXvgXzd6RZ7

Filing gate: should-fix S1 of the contract review of PR #31127 (comment 6707646253, card #31113), outside that card's claim. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane.
class: b (the skill contradicts the declared contract) · reach: every agent reading the published `objectstack-platform` skill.

## What is wrong

On `main` `5f003744`, `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` `### requires:` leads its token table with "Every other service plugin is opt-in". That is false for the tokens in `PLATFORM_ALWAYS_ON_CAPABILITIES` (`packages/spec/src/kernel/platform-capabilities.ts`): `resolveServedCapabilities` adds them to every boot unless `--preset minimal`. `package-registry` (row added by PR #31127) is one; the review counted about ten more already in the table. An author reads the lead and lists an always-on token in `requires:` (harmless) or believes a service is absent unless listed (wrong).

## Owed

Mark the always-on tokens in the table (or split the table), reword the lead to say which tokens are always-on and what `--preset minimal` drops, read from `PLATFORM_ALWAYS_ON_CAPABILITIES` and `resolveServedCapabilities` at the time of the fix. No count in prose (#27522). The file is at its token ceiling: pay by same-file deletion or the standing ruling.

**Level:** `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Related: #31113, PR #31127, #27522.
